newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end steady, seen high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end steady, seen high.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates held steady on Sunday, but overnight rates remained high because of a shortage of funds in the banking system, dealers said.
"Overnight calls were traded at 20 percent," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said. "Some activity was seen in five-month securities at 16.1 percent."
He said rates were likely to remain high on Monday.
The State (central) Bank plans to auction six-month short-term federal bonds on Tuesday with a pre-auction target of 8.0 billion rupees. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
